meta.notes: Modality is a property of the drug (INN grammar or curated mechanism). 'targets' are primary drug targets (HGNC symbols, emitted as role drug_target); 'targetsSecondary' are documented off-target/secondary kinases that are NOT emitted as tags. ADC payload and antibody are components: the payload never creates a separate modality. 'synonyms' and 'codes' are matched case-insensitively with flexible hyphen/space. 'caseSensitive' strings are matched exactly (used for short abbreviations such as T-DXd, PLD, ICI). 'parent': a formulation-specific entity suppresses its parent when both match (liposomal irinotecan vs irinotecan). isClass entries are named drug classes (e.g. 'CDK4/6 inhibitor'); class modality is null when the class spans modalities. company = originator/licensor id from companies.json; current owner is resolved through lineage. 'parent' is informational (formulation family); both entities are tagged when both are mentioned. contextSynonyms are accepted only when their context regex occurs in the presentation. meta.abbrVeto: a case-sensitive abbreviation is rejected in a presentation whose text matches the veto regex (e.g. ADC = apparent diffusion coefficient in MRI abstracts).
